item.text:
The source has a direct cause for each report, and existing checks cover all four. I found no `AGENTS.md`; the README and static checks define the available project rules, including strict TypeScript, files under 200 lines, no shipped audio, and an offline build.

The plan is:

1. Fix best scores so only a lower completed score replaces the saved value, and unfinished sizes show the expected empty marker.
2. Restore arrow-key navigation while preserving Tab exit, card activation, remembered focus, and scrolling.
3. Honor reduced motion for card transitions and the win banner, keeping normal-motion behavior.
4. Remove match and win sounds while preserving visual and screen-reader feedback.
5. Run formatting, type, unit, build, and browser checks on the combined result.

Each fix will have its own subagent. The workspace allows one active subagent at a time, so I’ll run them in sequence and review their changes without editing code myself.

- Best scores only improve; unfinished sizes show `none`.

- Reduced motion disables card and win-banner animations.
